newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to fulfil 1997 three pct deficit target-Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain to fulfil 1997 three pct deficit target-Rato.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Monday Spain would fulfil its 1997 deficit target of three percent of gross domestic product.
"The government guarantees that the public deficit trend in 1997 will come in line with that forecast, within a framework of jobs growth," Rato told reporters.
In a reference to the stability plan unveiled on Sunday, Rato said the plan intended to concentrate the government's reform efforts in its first few years.
The plan promises a sharp fall in public deficit and debt by 2000, while growth will run at three percent or above from 1997 to 2000.
